title: Topic 64 | Magnetic field. Magnetic field of a current

questions.text: Determine which of the following statements about permanent magnets are true and which are false.\n1) like poles attract each other;\n2) by cutting a magnet in two, one can obtain a magnet with only one pole.
At which points on Earth is a magnetic needle exactly horizontal?
What kind of field exists around a conductor carrying a direct current?
answers: an electric and a magnetic field.

questions.text: A first conductor carrying current $I_1=10$ A repels each 1 m length of a second conductor, parallel to it at a distance of 10 cm, with a force of $4 \cdot 10^{-4}$ N. What is the current in the second conductor (in amperes) and in which direction does it flow?
In which of the following definitions is the unit of current (1 A) defined correctly?
answers: the current at which a coil of inductance 1 H produces a flux of 1 Wb.
the current at which a charge of 1 C passes through the conductor cross-section in 1 s.
the current flowing through a conductor of resistance 1 $\Omega$.
the current that produces a force of $2 \cdot 10^{-7}$ N between parallel conductors 1 m apart in vacuum.
